evals.prompt: Add SolvaPay hosted checkout to my Next.js 14 App Router site. I need a server route that creates a checkout session and a return URL page at /billing/return that refreshes access from server-side purchase state.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads website-checkout, runs npx solvapay init guidance, implements server-side checkout session route per references/nextjs.md, return URL handler reads server truth.
assertions: Checkout session is created on the server, not via client-side calls with the secret key
Return URL flow refreshes access from server-side check (not query params alone)
Verification loop includes sandbox happy path

evals.prompt: I have a Vite + Supabase Lovable app — paste SolvaPay checkout in with @preview packages.
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/lovable-checkout skill, not website-checkout.
assertions: Handoff to solvapay/lovable-checkout or explicit note that Lovable path differs
Does not apply Next.js-only website-checkout patterns to the Lovable stack

evals.prompt: React 18 SPA with Vite frontend and a small Express API — add SolvaPay hosted checkout redirect and a return page. No Next.js in package.json.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/react.md for SPA + backend checkout session contract.
assertions: Agent does not assume App Router or references/nextjs.md as the only path
Checkout session creation is server-side on Express (or documented backend)

evals.prompt: Add SolvaPay usage metering, webhooks, and paywall middleware on all /api/premium routes in Express — full SDK integration.
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/sdk-integration, not website-checkout.
assertions: Handoff to solvapay/sdk-integration or explicit note that full SDK path is outside website-checkout
Agent does not treat hosted-checkout-only skill as the primary owner of usage events + webhooks
